errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait {{seconds}} seconds, then try again.
errors.rateLimitedNoTime: Too many attempts. Wait a minute, then try again.
errors.sessionExpired: Your session ended. Log in again to continue.
errors.loadFailed: We could not load your account.

validation.codeRequired: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app
validation.recoveryCodeRequired: Enter one of your recovery codes
validation.recoveryCodesSaved: Confirm that you saved your recovery codes

brand.description: Reception, consultations, pharmacy and billing for your facility, in one calm workspace.

login.title: Log in to MediLink
login.intro: For staff of verified health facilities.
login.invalidCredentials: The email or password is not right. Check them and try again.
login.patientHint: Looking for care? Patients use the MediLink app instead.

mfaSetup.title: Set up two-step login
mfaSetup.intro: Staff accounts need a second step at login to protect patient data.
mfaSetup.setupFailed: We could not start the setup. Log in again.
mfaSetup.step1Body: For example Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or another TOTP app, on a phone only you use.
mfaSetup.step2Title: 2. Scan this QR code with the app
mfaSetup.qrLabel: QR code to add your MediLink account to an authenticator app
mfaSetup.manualKeyLabel: Can’t scan? Enter this key in the app
mfaSetup.step3Title: 3. Enter the 6-digit code the app shows
mfaSetup.codesIntro: If you lose your phone, each code lets you log in once. Keep them somewhere safe, away from your phone. We will not show them again.
mfaSetup.savedConfirm: I have saved my recovery codes in a safe place

mfaVerify.title: Enter your login code
mfaVerify.intro: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code for MediLink.
mfaVerify.codeHint: Paste or type the code. Spaces are fine.
mfaVerify.useApp: Use the code from my app
mfaVerify.recoveryIntro: Enter one of the recovery codes you saved when you set up two-step login.
mfaVerify.recoveryHint: For example abcd-1234. Each code works once.

facility.title: Choose your facility
facility.intro: You work at more than one facility. Choose where you are working now. You can switch at any time from the top bar.
facility.switchFailed: We could not switch facility. Try again.

today.title: Today
today.platform: You are signed in as a platform admin.
today.placeholderTitle: Your Today board is on its way
today.placeholderBody: Expected patients, people on site and the live queue will appear here from Sprint 4. Your account, roles and facility are ready.

placeholder.title: {{section}}
placeholder.body: This workspace is planned for a later sprint.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: Check the address, or go back to your Today page.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.intro: Enter your work email. If it belongs to an account, we will send a link to set a new password.
forgot.sentBody: If an account exists for {{email}}, a reset link is on its way. The link works for 30 minutes.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.hint: At least 12 characters. A short phrase is easy to remember and hard to guess.
reset.doneBody: Your password was changed and you were logged out everywhere. Log in with your new password.
reset.invalidLink: This link is incomplete. Open the link from the email again, or ask for a new one.
